note: The BCF record header in the input controls the individual-section length; this candidate sets it to 3 bytes.
The three input-controlled individual-section bytes are copied into the heap buffer v->indiv.s and later checked as FORMAT data.
Validation begins with ptr at the start of the malformed individual section and end at ptr plus rec->indiv.l.
The FORMAT key decoder is invoked on the three-byte individual section, whose first byte declares an INT32 typed integer but supplies only two following bytes.
For BCF_BT_INT32, bcf_type_shift[t] is 2, so the guard accepts two remaining bytes even though a four-byte integer will be read.
The INT32 decoder reads four bytes from p while only two bytes remain in the logical individual section, producing the heap-buffer-overflow READ 4.
